status: implemented_locally_under_prospective_contract; static maps current; engine and publication pending
objective: Allow ordinary duty reporting to exit an actual constructed Vehicle Works through its own door without completing at an intermediate door.
owner: Developer C; rear_simulation.gd only plus diagram/evidence/maps. No publication or CI submission until explicit authorization.

authoritative_state.person: Existing ledger position, current/pending assignment and actor phase; same person after lawful fuel handoff or safe station extraction.
authoritative_state.facility: Existing heavy_owners/current bay place/site_door; ignore unused legacy owner in empty-field opening. Constructed owners persist while their bay exists, independent of a truck still occupying it.
authoritative_state.geometry: Existing walk_path/construction.walking_path validates all remaining footprints. No new collision geometry or general wall bypass.

commands: Existing _report called by safe reassignment/completion. For ordinary destinations resolve current origin and destination once, then one bounded heavy-owner lookup and one outward path query. Vehicle/manual duty branch unchanged.
route: At a matching actual bay centre, compose origin -> that owner.site_door -> destination only if the existing outward path is nonempty; otherwise return empty and retain Route blocked/INF. Else use existing normal walk_path.
events: No new signals, per-frame work, timer, queued work, cache, history or state owner. Existing _move and physical phase completion own motion/presence.
cancellation_lifecycle: Do not alter load release, carried custody, pending assignments, fuel/crew completion or safe reassignment. Resolve owners at _report time, not a retained route cache. Removed owner uses normal path admission.
reuse: Generalize existing legacy _report interior-door splice. Do not call vehicle_activity._walk_from because its unused legacy first-match bay can alias actual constructed bay coordinates in empty-field mode; that file remains outside ownership. Both routes reuse existing walk_path for outward geometry.
frozen_acceptance: Ordinary report from actual constructed bay starts a Reporting path through that exact owner door and continues to final assigned destination; no change to ledger position at submission.
Blocked or missing outward path produces empty route/Route blocked/INF, never a path ending just at the door.
A vacated constructed bay remains a valid exit origin for a worker left there; unused legacy bay in empty-field mode grants no special exit.
Other origin/manual vehicle routing, actor identity, assignment, custody/claims, staffing priority and all unrelated footprints remain unchanged.

prospective_demonstration.execution: NOT authorized or submitted; one brief GitHub input only if lead/Dawson approves. No local engine or old checkers.
prospective_demonstration.feasibility: ONE supplied current-owner bay/door and valid outward-path input. Actual Rear Empty/no-yard/empty-field constructor creates no people, goods, hull or completed facility. One geometry place only. Calls actual new helper and existing _move on one detached motion record.
prospective_demonstration.observe: ONE valid actual-owner bay->own door->final destination route and existing timed Reporting motion record. Other blocked/alias/unmatched behavior is source-reviewed only, not an execution proposal.
prospective_demonstration.limits: Detached owner/path/motion facts are not actual completed construction, lawful fuel handoff, actual crew extraction, physical worker arrival or ordinary gameplay acceptance. These remain unverified; no stock/resources/people/hulls created.
prospective_demonstration.previous_proposal: Prior broader UNEXECUTED proposal archived in ignored logs with raw and normalized hashes; see evidence. No existing run or rerun exists.

references: Existing vehicle_activity.gd::_walk_from and construction_service.gd::_clearance_path read directly.
limits: No local engine, regression writing/runs, broad scenarios, failure injection campaign, coverage matrix or benchmark. No price/rate/stock/threshold changes, teleport or forced access. Exact lead technical and Designer reviews required at new published head.
